fields.Name: T197 - Database Designer Entity Search Narrows Table
fields.Description: Exercises Database Designer's bespoke HTML-table filter pipeline (applyFilterAndSort over name/table/schema with its own zero-state), not the generic AG-Grid grid search covered by Data Explorer tests.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the Database Designer. Wait for the entity table to load (10-30s possible in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away). Database Designer shows a table of user-defined entities with columns Entity Name, Schema, Table, Owner, Created. There is a search box with placeholder 'Search by name, table, or schema...'. Type a partial term into it. Success is that the entity table RESPONDS: the rows narrow to matching entities and the count line below the table updates (or, if nothing matches, a 'No entities match ...' zero-state with a 'Clear search' button appears). Seeing the table respond to the search is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Database Designer renders an entity table with a name/table/schema search box
Typing in the search box narrows the rows to matches and updates the count line, OR shows a valid 'No entities match' zero-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
